title: Data & Automation Engineer
subtitle: OMNI Group
overview: First analyst hired; built the company's entire data and reporting function from scratch on a 150+ table SQL Server database with millions of rows.

details.approach: Designed an executive arrears dashboard covering 3,000+ live cases (CPI, PPI, Trust Deed) with drill-down into arrears, catch-up balances, and assignment-stage pipeline. Built a Node.js API layer to serve query results since direct DB access wasn't permitted for reporting tools, and engineered custom SQL logic with the co-founder/GM to recover ~50 cases silently dropped by the in-house system.
details.impact: Exposed £60K in previously invisible arrears and catch-up payments, tracked ~£500K in customer payments; dashboard adopted operationally by the co-founder/GM and two business teams.
